definitions.first_residue_only: Equal nonzero length, all characters after position1 equal, first characters differ.
definitions.terminal_stop_only: Strings differ only by one terminal asterisk on either side.

exports: Counts and IDs/hash/length examples only. No computed or deposited full AA string, no sequence editing. Aggregate first-residue counts may be recorded.
fixed_computation: Same Biopython1.86 feature.extract, same declared transl_table, same baseline codon_start offset, Seq.translate(cds=True); require recomputed SHA256 equal frozen baseline computed_sha256.
purpose: Post hoc descriptive classification of the unchanged strict translation-check mismatches; not an alternative translation check or correction.
representatives: First3 protein IDs in each category under lexical ordering, irrespective of phenotype.
selection: All and only3666 entries whose frozen baseline status is mismatch; do not select examples by phenotype or outcome.
